user.title: Connect to AISStream
user.description: Enter your AISStream API key and the vessels you want to track. AIS is a live stream: coordinates appear after a vessel transmits within coverage.

data_description.api_key: Create a key at aisstream.io. It is stored by Home Assistant and never included in the entity attributes.
data_description.vessels: Each line: 9-digit MMSI or 9-digit MMSI | Friendly name. Example: 211234567 | My ship. Up to 200 vessels.

reconfigure.title: Change AISStream API key
reconfigure.description: Replace the key used for the existing AISStream subscription.

data_description.api_key: The existing vessel list is retained.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to AISStream. Check your connection and try again.
error.invalid_mmsi: Invalid vessel list. Enter one unique 9-digit MMSI per line, optionally followed by | Name (maximum 200).
error.subscription_rejected: AISStream did not confirm the subscription. Check the key and service limits.

abort.reconfigure_successful: The AISStream API key was changed.

init.title: Configure tracked vessels
init.description: Edit the list to add or remove ships. Stale position reports become unavailable after the configured age.

data_description.vessels: Each line: MMSI or MMSI | Friendly name. Up to 200 unique 9-digit identifiers.
data_description.max_age_minutes: Positions older than this are marked unavailable (1–10080 minutes).

error.invalid_mmsi: Invalid vessel list. Use a unique 9-digit MMSI on each line (maximum 200).
